local scn, done = ...
local bot = player.GetBots()[1]
local thinks, frames, t = {}, {}, -10
local S = { Base = "weapon_base", Primary = { ClipSize = -1, DefaultClip = -1, Automatic = true, Ammo = "none" },
  Secondary = { ClipSize = -1, DefaultClip = -1, Automatic = false, Ammo = "none" } }
function S:Initialize() self:SetHoldType("pistol") end
function S:Deploy() return true end
function S:Think() thinks[#thinks+1] = { t = t, tick = engine.TickCount(), cur = CurTime(), frame = FrameNumber() } end
function S:PrimaryAttack() self:SetNextPrimaryFire(CurTime() + 0.2) end
weapons.Register(S, "parity_think")
local function held(tk)
  if tk >= 100 and tk < 150 then return IN_ATTACK end
  return 0
end
hook.Add("StartCommand", "parity_think", function(ply, cmd)
  if ply ~= bot then return end
  cmd:ClearButtons() cmd:ClearMovement() cmd:SetButtons(held(t))
end)
hook.Add("Think", "parity_think", function()
  t = t + 1
  frames[#frames+1] = { t = t, tick = engine.TickCount(), cur = CurTime(), frame = FrameNumber() }
  if t == 0 then bot:Give("parity_think") bot:SelectWeapon("parity_think") end
  if t == 200 then
    for _, h in ipairs({ "Think", "StartCommand" }) do hook.Remove(h, "parity_think") end
    done({ thinks = thinks, frames = frames, active = IsValid(bot:GetActiveWeapon()) and bot:GetActiveWeapon():GetClass() or "",
      interval = engine.TickInterval() })
  end
end)
return "async"
